103    public function start(Character $character, array $data): BatchCrafting
104    {
105        $type = BatchCraftingType::from($data['batch_type']);
106        $disposition = BatchCraftingDisposition::from($data['disposition']);
107
108        if (! $disposition->isAllowedFor($type, $data['progress'] ?? [])) {
109            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
110                'disposition' => 'This disposition is not allowed for this batch crafting type.',
111            ]);
112        }
113
114        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY && $this->isAlchemyLocked($character)) {
115            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
116                'batch_type' => 'You need to unlock Alchemy before you can batch craft alchemy items.',
117            ]);
118        }
119
120        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::HOLY_OILS && $this->isAlchemyLocked($character)) {
121            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
122                'batch_type' => 'You need to unlock Alchemy before you can batch craft with Holy Oils.',
123            ]);
124        }
125
126        if ($this->active($character)) {
127            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
128                'batch_crafting' => 'Batch crafting is already running for this character.',
129            ]);
130        }
131
132        if ($character->currentAutomations()->where('type', AutomationType::FACTION_LOYALTY->value)->where('completed_at', '>', now())->exists()) {
133            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
134                'batch_crafting' => 'Batch crafting cannot start while faction loyalty automation is running.',
135            ]);
136        }
137
138        if ($character->is_dead) {
139            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
140                'batch_crafting' => 'Batch crafting cannot start while the character is dead.',
141            ]);
142        }
143
144        if ($type !== BatchCraftingType::TRINKETRY && $this->currencyAmount($character, $type->requiredCurrency()) <= 0) {
145            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
146                'batch_crafting' => $this->missingRequiredCurrencyMessage($character, $type),
147            ]);
148        }
149
150        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::HOLY_OILS) {
151            $this->validateHolyOilSelections($character, $data);
152
153            if (in_array($disposition, [BatchCraftingDisposition::LIST, BatchCraftingDisposition::DISENCHANT], true)
154                && ! $this->holyOilDispositionEligible($character, $data, $disposition)) {
155                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
156                    'disposition' => $disposition === BatchCraftingDisposition::LIST
157                        ? 'Listing is only available when the targeted item(s) already have 1 or 2 enchants.'
158                        : 'Disenchanting is only available when the targeted item(s) already have enchants.',
159                ]);
160            }
161        }
162
163        $progress = $this->validatedProgress($character, $type, $data);
164
165        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::HOLY_OILS) {
166            $holyOilPlan = $this->holyOilApplicationPlan(
167                $character,
168                $data['selected_items'] ?? [],
169                $data['selected_oils'] ?? [],
170                $progress,
171            );
172            $progress['holy_oil_application_plan'] = $holyOilPlan;
173            $progress['holy_oil_application_results'] = [];
174            $progress['holy_oil_requested_applications'] = $holyOilPlan['applications_planned'];
175            $progress['holy_oil_completed_applications'] = 0;
176            $progress['holy_oil_plan_index'] = 0;
177        }
178        $maximumRequestAmount = $this->maximumRequestAmount($character, $type, $progress, $disposition);
179        $requestedAmount = $type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY
180            ? (int) ($progress['alchemy_amount'] ?? 0)
181            : (int) ($progress['craft_amount'] ?? 0);
182
183        $isAmountMode = ($type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY && ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'amount')
184            || (in_array($type, [BatchCraftingType::CRAFT, BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT], true) && ($progress['craft_mode'] ?? null) === 'specific_item');
185
186        if ($isAmountMode && $requestedAmount > $maximumRequestAmount) {
187            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
188                ($type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY ? 'progress.alchemy_amount' : 'progress.craft_amount') => 'The requested amount may not exceed '.number_format($maximumRequestAmount).' for the selected destination.',
189            ]);
190        }
191
192        if ($disposition === BatchCraftingDisposition::LIST
193            && $type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY
194            && ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'amount'
195            && isset($progress['alchemy_item_id'])) {
196            $alchemyItem = Item::find($progress['alchemy_item_id']);
197            $minPrice = is_null($alchemyItem) ? 0 : SellItemCalculator::fetchMinPrice($alchemyItem);
198
199            if ($minPrice > 0 && (int) ($data['listing_price'] ?? 0) < $minPrice) {
200                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
201                    'listing_price' => 'No! The minimum listing price is: '.number_format($minPrice).' Gold.',
202                ]);
203            }
204        }
205
206        $startBlockers = $this->startBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $data['selected_items'] ?? [], $data['selected_oils'] ?? [], $disposition);
207        $blockingMessages = array_values(array_map(
208            fn (array $blocker): string => $blocker['message'],
209            array_filter($startBlockers, fn (array $blocker): bool => $blocker['blocking'])
210        ));
211
212        if (! empty($blockingMessages)) {
213            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
214                'batch_crafting' => $blockingMessages,
215            ]);
216        }
217
218        $progress['tick_delay_seconds'] = $this->tickDelaySeconds($type, $progress);
219
220        if ($disposition === BatchCraftingDisposition::LIST) {
221            $progress['listing_price'] = (int) $data['listing_price'];
222        }
223
224        $requiresInitialFiniteDelay = $this->requiresInitialFiniteDelay($type, $progress);
225        $continuousFiniteMode = $this->isContinuousFiniteType($type, $progress);
226        $firstAttemptAt = now()->addSeconds($requiresInitialFiniteDelay
227            ? self::INITIAL_FINITE_DELAY_SECONDS
228            : $progress['tick_delay_seconds']);
229        $progress = array_merge($progress, match (true) {
230            $requiresInitialFiniteDelay => [
231                'continuation_active' => true,
232                'continuation_state' => 'waiting',
233                'continuation_reason' => 'initial_start_delay',
234                'continuation_message' => 'Batch Crafting will begin in one moment.',
235                'continuation_phase' => 'starting',
236                'continuation_item' => null,
237                'continuation_delay_seconds' => self::INITIAL_FINITE_DELAY_SECONDS,
238                'next_attempt_at' => $firstAttemptAt->toIso8601String(),
239            ],
240            $continuousFiniteMode => $this->clearedContinuationState(),
241            default => [
242                'continuation_active' => true,
243                'continuation_state' => 'waiting',
244                'continuation_reason' => 'continue_remaining_work',
245                'continuation_message' => 'Batch Crafting is waiting to begin the first requested attempt.',
246                'continuation_phase' => 'starting',
247                'continuation_item' => null,
248                'continuation_delay_seconds' => $progress['tick_delay_seconds'],
249                'next_attempt_at' => $firstAttemptAt->toIso8601String(),
250            ],
251        });
252
253        $batchCrafting = BatchCrafting::create([
254            'character_id' => $character->id,
255            'user_id' => $character->user_id,
256            'batch_type' => $type->value,
257            'disposition' => $disposition->value,
258            'started_at' => now(),
259            'ends_at' => now()->addHours(self::DURATION_HOURS),
260            'status' => 'running',
261            'progress' => $progress,
262            'selected_items' => $data['selected_items'] ?? [],
263            'selected_oils' => $data['selected_oils'] ?? [],
264        ]);
265
266        $this->logger()->batchStarted($batchCrafting, $character);
267
268        $startMessage = $requiresInitialFiniteDelay
269            ? 'Batch Crafting is scheduled and will begin in one minute.'
270            : 'Batch crafting has started. First action will run in '.$this->firstActionDelayMessage($progress['tick_delay_seconds']).'.';
271        event(new ServerMessageEvent($character->user, $startMessage));
272        event(new AutomationLogUpdate($character->user_id, $startMessage));
273        event(new BatchCraftingStatusUpdated($character->user_id));
274        event(new BatchCraftingMonitoringUpdated($character->id));
275
276        if (! app()->runningUnitTests()) {
277            $pendingDispatch = BatchCraftingJob::dispatch($batchCrafting->id);
278
279            if ($requiresInitialFiniteDelay || ! $this->isContinuousFiniteType($type, $progress)) {
280                $pendingDispatch->delay($firstAttemptAt);
281            }
282        }
283
284        return $batchCrafting;
285    }
286
287    public function isContinuousFiniteMode(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting): bool
288    {
289        return $batchCrafting->isRunning()
290            && $this->isContinuousFiniteType(BatchCraftingType::from($batchCrafting->batch_type), $batchCrafting->progress ?? []);
291    }
292
293    private function isContinuousFiniteType(BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress): bool
294    {
295        return match ($type) {
296            BatchCraftingType::CRAFT => in_array($progress['craft_mode'] ?? null, ['specific_item', 'craft_set'], true),
297            BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT => in_array($progress['craft_mode'] ?? null, ['specific_item', 'craft_enchant_set'], true),
298            BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY => ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'amount',
299            BatchCraftingType::HOLY_OILS => in_array($progress['holy_oil_mode'] ?? 'selected', ['selected', 'set'], true),
300            default => false,
301        };
302    }
303
304    private function requiresInitialFiniteDelay(BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress): bool
305    {
306        return match ($type) {
307            BatchCraftingType::CRAFT => in_array($progress['craft_mode'] ?? null, ['specific_item', 'craft_set'], true),
308            BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT => in_array($progress['craft_mode'] ?? null, ['specific_item', 'craft_enchant_set'], true),
309            BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY => ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'amount',
310            BatchCraftingType::HOLY_OILS => in_array($progress['holy_oil_mode'] ?? 'selected', ['selected', 'set'], true),
311            default => false,
312        };
313    }
314
315    public function preview(Character $character, array $data): array
316    {
317        $type = BatchCraftingType::from($data['batch_type']);
318        $progress = $data['progress'] ?? [];
319        $selectedItemIds = $data['selected_items'] ?? [];
320        $selectedOilIds = $data['selected_oils'] ?? [];
321        $disposition = isset($data['disposition']) ? BatchCraftingDisposition::from($data['disposition']) : BatchCraftingDisposition::KEEP;
322        $progress = $this->normalizeOutputDestination($type, $progress, $disposition);
323
324        return [
325            'cost_breakdown' => $this->costBreakdown($character, $type, $progress, $selectedItemIds, $selectedOilIds, $disposition),
326            'amount_preview' => $this->amountPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition),
327            'alchemy_amount_preview' => $this->alchemyAmountPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition),
328            'holy_oil_selected_preview' => $this->holyOilsSelectedPreview($character, $type, $selectedItemIds, $selectedOilIds, $progress),
329            'holy_oil_set_preview' => $this->holyOilsSetPreview($character, $type, $selectedOilIds, $progress),
330            'destination_capacity' => $this->destinationCapacityPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition),
331            'maximum_request_amount' => $this->maximumRequestAmount($character, $type, $progress, $disposition),
332            'start_blockers' => $this->startBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $selectedItemIds, $selectedOilIds, $disposition, true),
333        ];
334    }
335
336    /**
337     * Destination capacity can refer to Inventory, a specified normal Inventory Set,
338     * the Crafted Items Set, or the Alchemy Bag for Alchemy modes.
339     */
340    private function destinationCapacityPreview(Character $character, BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition): ?array
341    {
342        if ($this->requiresCraftedItemsSetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
343            $batchCraftingSet = $this->batchCraftingSetService->getOrCreateForCharacter($character);
344
345            return [
346                'destination' => 'crafted_items_set',
347                'destination_label' => 'Crafted Items Set',
348                'current' => $batchCraftingSet->currentSlotCount(),
349                'max' => $batchCraftingSet->max_slots,
350                'remaining' => $batchCraftingSet->remainingSlots(),
351            ];
352        }
353
354        if ($this->requiresAlchemyBagCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
355            return [
356                'destination' => 'alchemy_bag',
357                'destination_label' => 'Alchemy Bag',
358                'current' => $character->getAlchemyBagCount(),
359                'max' => $character->alchemy_bag_limit,
360                'remaining' => max(0, $character->alchemy_bag_limit - $character->getAlchemyBagCount()),
361            ];
362        }
363
364        if ($this->requiresInventoryCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
365            return [
366                'destination' => 'inventory',
367                'destination_label' => 'Inventory',
368                'current' => $character->getInventoryCount(),
369                'max' => $character->inventory_max,
370                'remaining' => max(0, $character->inventory_max - $character->getInventoryCount()),
371            ];
372        }
373
374        if ($this->requiresInventorySetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
375            $outputSet = InventorySet::where('id', $progress['output_set_id'] ?? 0)->where('character_id', $character->id)->first();
376
377            if (is_null($outputSet)) {
378                return null;
379            }
380
381            return [
382                'destination' => 'inventory_set',
383                'destination_label' => $this->inventorySetDisplayName($character, $outputSet),
384                'current' => $outputSet->currentSlotCount(),
385                'max' => $outputSet->max_slots,
386                'remaining' => $outputSet->remainingSlots(),
387            ];
388        }
389
390        return null;
391    }

393    private function maximumRequestAmount(Character $character, BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition): int
394    {
395        if (! in_array($disposition, [BatchCraftingDisposition::KEEP], true)) {
396            return 2000;
397        }
398
399        $capacity = $this->destinationCapacityPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition);
400
401        if (is_null($capacity)) {
402            return 2000;
403        }
404
405        return min(2000, max(0, (int) $capacity['remaining']));
406    }

408    private function startBlockers(Character $character, BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress, array $selectedItemIds, array $selectedOilIds, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition, bool $includePreviewPlanBlockers = false): array
409    {
410        $craftMode = $progress['craft_mode'] ?? null;
411
412        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::CRAFT && $craftMode === 'specific_item') {
413            return $this->amountModeStartBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $this->amountPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition), $disposition);
414        }
415
416        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::CRAFT && $craftMode === 'craft_set') {
417            return $this->craftSetStartBlockers($character, $progress, false, $disposition, $includePreviewPlanBlockers);
418        }
419
420        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT && $craftMode === 'specific_item') {
421            return array_merge(
422                $this->manualSelectedAffixIntBlockers($character, $progress['enchant_affix_ids'] ?? []),
423                $this->amountModeStartBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $this->amountPreview($character, $type, $progress, $disposition), $disposition)
424            );
425        }
426
427        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT && $craftMode === 'craft_enchant_set') {
428            return $this->craftSetStartBlockers($character, $progress, true, $disposition, $includePreviewPlanBlockers);
429        }
430
431        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY && ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'amount') {
432            return $this->alchemyAmountStartBlockers($character, $progress, $disposition);
433        }
434
435        if (in_array($type, [BatchCraftingType::CRAFT, BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT], true) && $craftMode === 'experience') {
436            if (! $this->requiresCraftedItemsSetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
437                return [];
438            }
439
440            return $this->craftedItemsSetCapacityBlockers($character, $this->retainedCraftedItemsSetSlots($type, $progress, $disposition));
441        }
442
443        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::TRINKETRY) {
444            $blockers = $this->trinketryStartBlockers($character);
445
446            if (! $this->requiresCraftedItemsSetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
447                return $blockers;
448            }
449
450            return array_merge(
451                $blockers,
452                $this->craftedItemsSetCapacityBlockers($character, $this->retainedCraftedItemsSetSlots($type, $progress, $disposition)),
453            );
454        }
455
456        if ($type === BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY && ($progress['alchemy_mode'] ?? null) === 'experience') {
457            if (! $this->requiresAlchemyBagCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
458                return [];
459            }
460
461            return $this->alchemyBagCapacityBlockers($character, $this->retainedAlchemyBagSlots($disposition));
462        }
463
464        return [];
465    }

467    private function trinketryStartBlockers(Character $character): array
468    {
469        $cost = $this->processor->trinketryCostPreview($character);
470
471        if (is_null($cost)) {
472            return [[
473                'code' => 'trinketry_item_unavailable',
474                'message' => 'No XP-eligible trinket is currently available.',
475                'blocking' => true,
476            ]];
477        }
478
479        $missingCurrencies = [];
480
481        foreach (['gold_dust' => 'Gold Dust', 'copper_coins' => 'Copper Coins'] as $currency => $label) {
482            if ($cost[$currency]['missing'] > 0) {
483                $missingCurrencies[] = $label
484                    .' required '.number_format($cost[$currency]['required'])
485                    .', available '.number_format($cost[$currency]['available'])
486                    .', missing '.number_format($cost[$currency]['missing']);
487            }
488        }
489
490        if (empty($missingCurrencies)) {
491            return [];
492        }
493
494        return [[
495            'code' => 'trinketry_insufficient_currencies',
496            'message' => 'Batch Trinketry cannot start crafting '.$cost['item_name'].'. Missing: '.implode('; ', $missingCurrencies).'.',
497            'blocking' => true,
498        ]];
499    }

604    private function manualSelectedAffixIntBlockers(Character $character, array $affixIds): array
605    {
606        $affixIds = array_values(array_filter($affixIds, fn ($affixId) => ! is_null($affixId)));
607
608        if (empty($affixIds)) {
609            return [];
610        }
611
612        $characterInt = $character->getInformation()->statMod('int');
613        $affixes = ItemAffix::whereIn('id', $affixIds)->get();
614        $blockers = [];
615
616        foreach ($affixes as $affix) {
617            if ($characterInt >= $affix->int_required) {
618                continue;
619            }
620
621            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
622                'int_too_low_for_enchanting',
623                $affix->name.' requires '.number_format($affix->int_required).' INT. You have '.number_format($characterInt).' INT.',
624                $this->intGuidanceLinks(),
625                true,
626                [
627                    'affix_id' => $affix->id,
628                    'affix_name' => $affix->name,
629                    'affix_type' => $affix->type,
630                    'int_required' => $affix->int_required,
631                    'character_int' => $characterInt,
632                ]
633            );
634        }
635
636        return $blockers;
637    }

639    private function amountModeStartBlockers(Character $character, BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress, ?array $preview, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition): array
640    {
641        if (is_null($preview)) {
642            return [];
643        }
644
645        $blockers = [];
646
647        if ($preview['total_cost'] > $preview['available_gold']) {
648            $missing = $preview['total_cost'] - $preview['available_gold'];
649
650            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
651                'not_enough_gold',
652                'You do not have enough Gold to start this batch. Required: '.number_format($preview['total_cost']).', Available: '.number_format($preview['available_gold']).', Missing: '.number_format($missing).'.'
653            );
654        }
655
656        if (! $this->keepsOutputInCraftedItemsSet($disposition)) {
657            return $blockers;
658        }
659
660        return array_merge($blockers, $this->outputDestinationStartBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $disposition, max(1, $preview['remaining_requested_amount'])));
661    }

663    /**
664     * Authoritative start-time capacity/validity blockers for the resolved output
665     * destination of a finite retained-output batch (Inventory / Specified Empty Set /
666     * Crafted Items Set). Reuses targetSetStartBlockers() for a specified set so
667     * ownership, equipped, empty and capacity rules are never duplicated.
668     */
669    private function outputDestinationStartBlockers(Character $character, BatchCraftingType $type, array $progress, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition, int $requiredSlots): array
670    {
671        if ($this->requiresInventorySetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
672            return $this->targetSetStartBlockers($character, (int) ($progress['output_set_id'] ?? 0), $requiredSlots, false);
673        }
674
675        if ($this->requiresInventoryCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
676            return $this->inventoryCapacityBlockers($character, $requiredSlots);
677        }
678
679        if ($this->requiresCraftedItemsSetCapacity($type, $progress, $disposition)) {
680            return $this->craftedItemsSetCapacityBlockers($character, $requiredSlots);
681        }
682
683        return [];
684    }

686    private function alchemyAmountStartBlockers(Character $character, array $progress, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition): array
687    {
688        $preview = $this->alchemyAmountPreview($character, BatchCraftingType::ALCHEMY, $progress, $disposition);
689
690        if (is_null($preview)) {
691            return [];
692        }
693
694        $blockers = [];
695
696        if ($preview['total_gold_dust_cost'] > $preview['available_gold_dust']) {
697            $missing = $preview['total_gold_dust_cost'] - $preview['available_gold_dust'];
698
699            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
700                'not_enough_gold_dust',
701                'You do not have enough Gold Dust to start this batch. Required: '.number_format($preview['total_gold_dust_cost']).', Available: '.number_format($preview['available_gold_dust']).', Missing: '.number_format($missing).'.'
702            );
703        }
704
705        if ($preview['total_shards_cost'] > $preview['available_shards']) {
706            $missing = $preview['total_shards_cost'] - $preview['available_shards'];
707
708            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
709                'not_enough_shards',
710                'You do not have enough Shards to start this batch. Required: '.number_format($preview['total_shards_cost']).', Available: '.number_format($preview['available_shards']).', Missing: '.number_format($missing).'.'
711            );
712        }
713
714        if (! $this->keepsOutputInAlchemyBag($disposition)) {
715            return $blockers;
716        }
717
718        if ($preview['bag_remaining'] <= 0) {
719            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
720                'alchemy_bag_full',
721                'Your Alchemy Bag is full. Empty space before starting this batch.'
722            );
723
724            return $blockers;
725        }
726
727        if ($preview['remaining_requested_amount'] > $preview['bag_remaining']) {
728            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
729                'alchemy_bag_not_enough_space',
730                'Your Alchemy Bag does not have enough space. Requested: '.number_format($preview['remaining_requested_amount']).', Remaining space: '.number_format($preview['bag_remaining']).'.'
731            );
732        }
733
734        return $blockers;
735    }

737    private function craftSetStartBlockers(Character $character, array $progress, bool $includeEnchanting, BatchCraftingDisposition $disposition, bool $includePreviewPlanBlockers): array
738    {
739        $planKey = $includeEnchanting ? 'enchant_plan' : 'craft_set_plan';
740        $plan = is_array($progress[$planKey] ?? null) ? $progress[$planKey] : [];
741        $breakdown = $this->craftSetCostBreakdown($character, [], $includeEnchanting, $plan, false, $progress);
742        $blockers = $includeEnchanting ? $this->craftEnchantSetPlanIntBlockers($character, $plan) : [];
743
744        foreach ($includePreviewPlanBlockers ? ($breakdown['plan_entries'] ?? []) : [] as $entry) {
745            $targetLabel = (string) ($entry['label'] ?? ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', (string) ($entry['target']['type'] ?? $entry['key']))));
746            $requestedSelectedItemId = $entry['requested_selected_item_id'] ?? null;
747
748            if (! is_null($requestedSelectedItemId) && ! ($entry['selected_item_available'] ?? false)) {
749                $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
750                    'craft_plan_selected_item_unavailable',
751                    'The selected item for '.$targetLabel.' is no longer craftable. Select another item before starting.',
752                    [],
753                    true,
754                    ['plan_key' => $entry['key'], 'selected_item_id' => $requestedSelectedItemId, 'target_label' => $targetLabel]
755                );
756
757                continue;
758            }
759
760            if (empty($entry['available_items']) && ! ($entry['optional'] ?? false)) {
761                $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
762                    'craft_plan_no_craftable_item',
763                    'No craftable item is currently available for '.$targetLabel.'.',
764                    [],
765                    true,
766                    ['plan_key' => $entry['key'], 'target_label' => $targetLabel]
767                );
768            }
769        }
770
771        $selectedHands = collect($breakdown['plan_entries'] ?? [])
772            ->filter(fn (array $entry) => $entry['category'] === 'hand' && $entry['included'])
773            ->map(fn (array $entry) => Item::find($entry['selected_item_id']))
774            ->filter();
775
776        if (! $this->setHandsValidation->areHandItemsValid($selectedHands)) {
777            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
778                'craft_set_invalid_hand_combination',
779                'A two-handed weapon occupies both hands. Clear the other hand before starting.',
780                [],
781                true
782            );
783        }
784
785        if (! ($breakdown['can_afford_full_plan'] ?? true)) {
786            $blockers[] = $this->blocker(
787                'not_enough_gold',
788                'You do not have enough Gold to start this batch. Required: '.number_format((int) $breakdown['total_required_gold']).', Available: '.number_format((int) $character->gold).', Missing: '.number_format((int) $breakdown['missing_currency_amount']).'.'
789            );
790        }
791
792        if (! $this->keepsOutputInCraftedItemsSet($disposition)) {
793            return $blockers;
794        }
795
796        $type = $includeEnchanting ? BatchCraftingType::CRAFT_AND_ENCHANT : BatchCraftingType::CRAFT;
797
798        return array_merge($blockers, $this->outputDestinationStartBlockers($character, $type, $progress, $disposition, (int) ($breakdown['planned_items'] ?? 0)));
799    }

801    /**
802     * Mirrors BatchCraftingProcessor::shouldMoveKeptOutputToBatchSet() for start-time

976        if (is_null($set)) {
977            return [$this->blocker(

1035    private function validateEnchantableSetComposition(InventorySet $set): array
1036    {
1037        $invalidResult = ['valid' => false, 'has_enchants' => false, 'message' => $this->invalidSetCompositionMessage()];
1038        $items = $set->slots()->with('item')->get()->map(fn (SetSlot $slot) => $slot->item)->filter();
1039
1040        if ($items->count() !== 23) {
1041            return $invalidResult;
1042        }
1043
1044        if ($items->contains(fn (Item $item) => $item->is_unique || $item->is_mythic || $item->is_cosmic)) {
1045            return $invalidResult;
1046        }
1047
1048        $typeCounts = $items->countBy(fn (Item $item) => $item->type);
1049
1050        foreach (ItemType::validWeapons() as $weaponType) {
1051            if (($typeCounts[$weaponType] ?? 0) !== 1) {
1052                return $invalidResult;
1053            }
1054        }
1055
1056        foreach (ArmourType::allTypes() as $armourType) {
1057            if (($typeCounts[$armourType] ?? 0) !== 1) {
1058                return $invalidResult;
1059            }
1060        }
1061
1062        if (($typeCounts[ItemType::RING->value] ?? 0) !== 2) {
1063            return $invalidResult;
1064        }
1065
1066        if (($typeCounts[ItemType::SPELL_DAMAGE->value] ?? 0) !== 1 || ($typeCounts[ItemType::SPELL_HEALING->value] ?? 0) !== 1) {
1067            return $invalidResult;
1068        }
1069
1070        $hasEnchants = $items->contains(fn (Item $item) => ! is_null($item->item_prefix_id) || ! is_null($item->item_suffix_id));
1071
1072        return ['valid' => true, 'has_enchants' => $hasEnchants, 'message' => null];
1073    }

1221            $suffixCost = 0;
1222
1223            if ($includeEnchanting && $included && ! is_null($item)) {
1224                if (! is_null($prefixId)) {
1225                    $prefixCost = $this->enchantingService->getCostOfEnchantment($character, [$prefixId], $item->id);
1226                }
1227
1228                if (! is_null($suffixId)) {
1229                    $suffixCost = $this->enchantingService->getCostOfEnchantment($character, [$suffixId], $item->id);
1230                }
1231
1232                if (! is_null($prefixId) || ! is_null($suffixId)) {
1233                    $configuredItems++;
1234                    $enchantCost += $prefixCost + $suffixCost;
1235                }
1236            }
1237
1238            $planEntries[] = [
1239                'key' => $entry['key'],
1240                'label' => $entry['target']['label'],
1241                'category' => $entry['target']['category'],
1242                'optional' => $entry['target']['optional'],
1243                'included' => $included,
1244                'target' => $entry['target'],
1245                'requested_selected_item_id' => $entry['requested_selected_item_id'],
1246                'selected_item_available' => $entry['selected_item_available'],
1247                'selected_item_id' => $item?->id,
1248                'selected_item_name' => $item?->affix_name ?? $item?->name,
1249                'selected_item_cost' => (int) ($item?->cost ?? 0),
1250                'selected_item_details' => is_null($item) ? null : $this->itemTransformer->transform($item),
1251                'selected_item_type' => $item?->type,
1252                'selected_item_handedness' => is_null($item) ? null : $this->setHandsValidation->handedness($item),
1253                'prefix_cost' => $prefixCost,
1254                'suffix_cost' => $suffixCost,
1255                'available_items' => $entry['available_items'],
1256            ];
1257        }
1258
1259        $totalRequired = $craftCost + $enchantCost;
1260
1261        $breakdown['total_cost_known'] = true;
1262        $breakdown['destination'] = $isEnchantExisting ? 'Selected Inventory Set' : $this->outputDestinationLabel($character, $progress);
1263        $plannedItems = collect($previewItems)->where('included', true)->count();
1264        $breakdown['planned_items'] = $plannedItems;
1265        $breakdown['configured_items'] = $includeEnchanting ? $configuredItems : $plannedItems;
1266        $breakdown['craft_cost_total'] = $craftCost;
1267        $breakdown['enchant_cost_total'] = $includeEnchanting ? $enchantCost : 0;
1268        $breakdown['total_required_gold'] = $totalRequired;
1269        $breakdown['total_required'] = $totalRequired;
1270        $breakdown['required_to_start'] = $totalRequired;
1271        $breakdown['missing_currency_amount'] = max(0, $totalRequired - (int) $character->gold);
1272        $breakdown['can_afford_full_plan'] = (int) $character->gold >= $totalRequired;
1273        $breakdown['can_afford_start'] = (int) $character->gold >= $totalRequired && $totalRequired > 0;
1274        $breakdown['effective_amount'] = $breakdown['can_afford_start'] ? $plannedItems : 0;
1275        $breakdown['enchant_has_failure_risk'] = $includeEnchanting && $this->enchantingSkillLevel($character) < 400;
1276        $breakdown['default_prefix_affix_id'] = $defaultPrefix?->id;
1277        $breakdown['default_prefix_affix_name'] = $defaultPrefix?->name;
1278        $breakdown['default_suffix_affix_id'] = $defaultSuffix?->id;
1279        $breakdown['default_suffix_affix_name'] = $defaultSuffix?->name;
1280        $breakdown['plan_entries'] = $planEntries;
1281
1282        return $breakdown;
1283    }
1284
1285    /**
1286     * Highest valid affix of the given type for this character: enchanting skill and
1287     * INT requirements met, ranked by skill_level_required, then cost, then id, all
1288     * descending/stable so the pick is deterministic.
1289     */
1290    private function highestValidAffix(Character $character, string $affixType): ?ItemAffix
1291    {
1292        $enchantingLevel = $this->enchantingSkillLevel($character);
1293        $characterInt = $character->getInformation()->statMod('int');
1294
1295        return ItemAffix::where('type', $affixType)
1296            ->where('randomly_generated', false)
1297            ->where('skill_level_required', '<=', $enchantingLevel)
1298            ->where('int_required', '<=', $characterInt)
1299            ->orderByDesc('skill_level_required')
1300            ->orderByDesc('cost')
1301            ->orderBy('id')
1302            ->first();
1303    }
1304
1305    private function selectedItemIdsFromPlan(array $plan): array
1306    {
1307        $selectedItemIds = [];
1308
1309        foreach ($plan as $key => $entry) {
1310            if (! is_array($entry) || ! isset($entry['selected_item_id']) || is_null($entry['selected_item_id'])) {
1311                continue;
1312            }
1313
1314            $selectedItemIds[$key] = (int) $entry['selected_item_id'];
1315        }
1316
1317        return $selectedItemIds;
1318    }

1320    public function active(Character $character): ?BatchCrafting
1321    {
1322        $activeId = BatchCrafting::where('character_id', $character->id)
1323            ->whereNull('completed_at')
1324            ->whereNull('cancelled_at')
1325            ->max('id');
1326
1327        if (is_null($activeId)) {
1328            return null;
1329        }
1330
1331        return BatchCrafting::find($activeId);
1332    }

1334    public function visible(Character $character): ?BatchCrafting
1335    {

1339            return $activeBatchCrafting;
1340        }
1341
1342        $visibleId = BatchCrafting::where('character_id', $character->id)
1343            ->whereNull('panel_dismissed_at')
1344            ->where(function ($query) {
1345                $query->whereNotNull('completed_at')
1346                    ->orWhereNotNull('cancelled_at');
1347            })
1348            ->max('id');
1349
1350        if (is_null($visibleId)) {
1351            return null;
1352        }
1353
1354        return BatchCrafting::find($visibleId);
1355    }

1569    /**

1591    public function process(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting): BatchCrafting
1592    {

1594            return $this->processOneOperation($batchCrafting);
1595        }
1596
1597        for ($operation = 0; $operation < self::ITEMS_PER_RECURRING_TICK; $operation++) {
1598            $batchCrafting = $this->processOneOperation($batchCrafting->refresh());
1599
1600            if (! $this->isContinuousFiniteMode($batchCrafting)) {
1601                break;
1602            }
1603        }
1604
1605        return $batchCrafting;
1606    }

1608    public function processOneOperation(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting): BatchCrafting
1609    {
1610        if (! $batchCrafting->isRunning()) {

1612        }

1614        $character = $batchCrafting->character()->first();
1615
1616        if ($character->is_dead) {

1649        $currencyBefore = $this->currencyAmount($character, $currency);

1667        if (isset($result['end_reason'])) {

1674                        return $action;
1675                    }
1676
1677                    $action['int_stop_details'] = $progress['int_stop_details'];

1681                }, $result['actions'] ?? []);

1684            $counts = $result['counts'] ?? [];
1685
1686            foreach ($counts as $column => $increment) {
1687                if (! in_array($column, [
1688                    'crafted_count',
1689                    'sold_count',
1690                    'destroyed_count',
1691                    'listed_count',
1692                    'kept_count',
1693                    'applied_count',
1694                    'skipped_count',
1695                    'failed_count',
1696                ])) {
1697                    continue;
1698                }

1700                $batchCrafting->increment($column, $increment);
1701            }
1702
1703            if (! empty($result['actions'] ?? [])) {
1704                $this->appendActionLog($batchCrafting, $counts, $result['actions']);
1705                $this->logActions($batchCrafting, $result['actions']);
1706            }
1707
1708            $this->recordProgressTotals($batchCrafting->refresh(), $counts, $result['actions'] ?? []);
1709            $this->recordChartPoint($batchCrafting->refresh(), $currency, $currencyBefore, $counts, $result['actions'] ?? []);
1710
1711            return $this->complete($batchCrafting, $result['end_reason']);
1712        }
1713
1714        $counts = $result['counts'] ?? [];
1715
1716        foreach ($counts as $column => $increment) {
1717            if (! in_array($column, [
1718                'crafted_count',
1719                'sold_count',
1720                'destroyed_count',
1721                'listed_count',
1722                'kept_count',
1723                'applied_count',
1724                'skipped_count',
1725                'failed_count',
1726            ])) {
1727                continue;
1728            }
1729
1730            $batchCrafting->update([
1731                $column => ((int) $batchCrafting->{$column}) + $increment,
1732            ]);
1733        }
1734
1735        if (! empty($counts) || ! empty($result['actions'] ?? [])) {

1737        }
1738
1739        if (! empty($result['actions'] ?? [])) {
1740            $this->logActions($batchCrafting, $result['actions']);
1741        }
1742
1743        $this->recordProgressTotals($batchCrafting->refresh(), $counts, $result['actions'] ?? []);
1744        $this->recordChartPoint($batchCrafting->refresh(), $currency, $currencyBefore, $counts, $result['actions'] ?? []);
1745        if ($this->isContinuousFiniteMode($batchCrafting->refresh())) {

1747                return ($action['status'] ?? $this->actionStatus($action)) === 'failed';
1748            });
1749            $progress = array_merge($batchCrafting->refresh()->progress ?? [], [
1750                'continuation_active' => true,

1752                'continuation_reason' => null,

1755                'continuation_item' => null,
1756                'continuation_delay_seconds' => 0,
1757                'next_attempt_at' => null,
1758                'last_tick_failed_count' => (int) ($counts['failed_count'] ?? 0),

1761                'last_tick_failure_phase' => $latestFailedAction['phase'] ?? null,
1762                'last_tick_failure_action' => $latestFailedAction['action'] ?? null,
1763                'last_tick_retry_delay_seconds' => 0,
1764            ]);

1766        } else {

1768        }
1769
1770        event(new BatchCraftingStatusUpdated($batchCrafting->user_id));

1772
1773        if (! empty($counts)) {

1780    /**
1781     * Per-tick summary shown in place of individual manual-style crafting/
1782     * enchanting/alchemy/trinketry/sell/list/disenchant messages, since a single
1783     * batch tick can process many items and firing one player-facing message per
1784     * item would spam the message log. Action history still carries the exact
1785     * outcome of every individual item.
1786     */
1787    private function tickSummaryMessage(array $counts): string
1788    {
1789        $labels = [
1790            'crafted_count' => 'crafted',
1791            'enchanted_count' => 'enchanted',
1792            'kept_count' => 'kept',
1793            'sold_count' => 'sold',
1794            'destroyed_count' => 'destroyed',
1795            'listed_count' => 'listed',
1796            'disenchanted_count' => 'disenchanted',
1797            'applied_count' => 'applied Holy Oil to',
1798            'used_count' => 'used',
1799            'failed_count' => 'failed to process',
1800            'skipped_count' => 'skipped',
1801        ];
1802
1803        $parts = [];
1804
1805        foreach ($labels as $column => $label) {
1806            $amount = (int) ($counts[$column] ?? 0);
1807
1808            if ($amount > 0) {
1809                $parts[] = $label.' '.number_format($amount).($amount === 1 ? ' item' : ' items');
1810            }
1811        }
1812
1813        if (empty($parts)) {
1814            return 'Batch crafting processed this chunk with no item changes.';
1815        }
1816
1817        return 'Batch crafting update: '.implode(', ', $parts).'.';
1818    }
1819
1820    /**
1821     * When a tick leaves normal-failure remaining work behind, the batch still has
1822     * finite remaining work (amount/set/holy oil modes), or a Craft/Craft and Enchant
1823     * experience-mode cycle is mid-way through its 6/6/6/5 chunks, retry quickly
1824     * instead of waiting for the full recurring delay. Open-ended experience modes
1825     * with no finite remaining amount, and experience cycles that just completed,
1826     * keep the recurring delay.
1827     */
1828    private function applyRetryDelay(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting, array $counts, array $actions): void
1829    {
1830        $progress = $batchCrafting->progress ?? [];
1831        $hadNormalFailureThisTick = (int) ($counts['failed_count'] ?? 0) > 0;
1832        $hadDestroyedEventEnchantThisTick = collect($actions)->contains(function (array $action): bool {
1833            return ($action['status'] ?? $this->actionStatus($action)) === 'destroyed'
1834                && in_array($action['action'] ?? null, ['event_enchant', 'event_fallback_enchant'], true);
1835        });
1836        $remaining = $this->remainingAmount($progress);
1837        $hasRemainingFiniteWork = ! is_null($remaining) && $remaining > 0;
1838        $hasIncompleteExperienceCycle = $this->hasIncompleteExperienceCycle($batchCrafting, $progress);
1839
1840        $delaySeconds = ($hadNormalFailureThisTick || $hadDestroyedEventEnchantThisTick || $hasRemainingFiniteWork || $hasIncompleteExperienceCycle)
1841            ? self::IMMEDIATE_DELAY_SECONDS
1842            : self::RECURRING_DELAY_SECONDS;
1843        $progress['tick_delay_seconds'] = $delaySeconds;
1844
1845        $latestFailedAction = null;
1846
1847        foreach (array_reverse($actions) as $action) {
1848            $actionStatus = $action['status'] ?? $this->actionStatus($action);
1849
1850            if ($actionStatus === 'failed') {
1851                $latestFailedAction = $action;
1852
1853                break;
1854            }
1855        }
1856
1857        $currentTickFailedCount = (int) ($counts['failed_count'] ?? 0);
1858
1859        $progress['last_tick_failed_count'] = $currentTickFailedCount;
1860        $progress['last_tick_had_failure'] = $currentTickFailedCount > 0;
1861        $progress['last_tick_failure_reason'] = $latestFailedAction['failure'] ?? null;
1862        $progress['last_tick_failure_phase'] = $latestFailedAction['phase'] ?? null;
1863        $progress['last_tick_failure_action'] = $latestFailedAction['action'] ?? null;
1864        $progress['last_tick_retry_delay_seconds'] = $delaySeconds;
1865
1866        $progress = array_merge($progress, $this->resolveContinuationForNextTick(
1867            $batchCrafting,
1868            $progress,
1869            $actions,
1870            $delaySeconds,
1871            $hasRemainingFiniteWork || $hasIncompleteExperienceCycle
1872        ));
1873
1874        $batchCrafting->update(['progress' => $progress]);
1875    }
1876
1877    /**
1878     * Persistent continuation state visible to the frontend between ticks: which
1879     * reason is driving the next attempt (priority: latest partial-enchant-discard,
1880     * then latest destroyed Craft and Enchant item, then latest plain failure, then
1881     * "more finite work remains"), the exact next-attempt timestamp, and the
1882     * current phase/item so the panel never looks frozen while waiting.
1883     */
1884    private function resolveContinuationForNextTick(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting, array $progress, array $actions, int $delaySeconds, bool $hasRemainingWork): array
1885    {
1886        $latestPartialDiscarded = null;
1887        $latestDestroyed = null;
1888        $latestDestroyedEventEnchant = null;
1889        $latestFailed = null;
1890
1891        foreach (array_reverse($actions) as $action) {
1892            $status = $action['status'] ?? $this->actionStatus($action);
1893            $actionType = (string) ($action['action'] ?? '');
1894
1895            if (is_null($latestPartialDiscarded) && $status === 'partial_enchant_discarded') {
1896                $latestPartialDiscarded = $action;
1897            }
1898
1899            $isCraftAndEnchantAction = str_contains($actionType, 'craft_and_enchant') || str_contains($actionType, 'craft_enchant_set_enchant');
1900
1901            if (is_null($latestDestroyed) && $status === 'destroyed' && $isCraftAndEnchantAction) {
1902                $latestDestroyed = $action;
1903            }
1904
1905            if (is_null($latestDestroyedEventEnchant) && $status === 'destroyed' && in_array($actionType, ['event_enchant', 'event_fallback_enchant'], true)) {
1906                $latestDestroyedEventEnchant = $action;
1907            }
1908
1909            if (is_null($latestFailed) && $status === 'failed') {
1910                $latestFailed = $action;
1911            }
1912        }
1913
1914        $reason = null;
1915        $message = null;
1916
1917        if (! is_null($latestPartialDiscarded)) {
1918            $reason = 'recraft_partial_enchant';
1919            $message = 'The item did not receive every requested enchantment. It was discarded, and a replacement will be crafted and enchanted again.';
1920        } elseif (! is_null($latestDestroyed)) {
1921            $reason = 'recraft_destroyed_item';
1922            $message = 'The item shattered during enchanting. A replacement will be crafted and enchanted again.';
1923        } elseif (! is_null($latestFailed)) {
1924            $reason = 'retry_failed_attempt';
1925            $message = 'That attempt failed, but Batch Crafting is still running and will try again.';
1926        } elseif (! is_null($latestDestroyedEventEnchant)) {
1927            $reason = 'retry_failed_attempt';
1928            $message = 'The event item shattered while enchanting. Batch Crafting will continue with the next event item or craft a replacement.';
1929        } elseif ($batchCrafting->isRunning()) {
1930            $reason = 'continue_remaining_work';
1931            $message = $hasRemainingWork
1932                ? 'Batch Crafting is continuing with the remaining requested work.'
1933                : 'Batch Crafting is waiting before the next scheduled attempt.';
1934        }

2378    private function recordChartPoint(BatchCrafting $batchCrafting, string $currency, int $currencyBefore, array $counts, array $actions): void

2400
2401        $listedValue = collect($actions)->sum(fn (array $action) => (int) ($action['listed_price'] ?? 0));
2402
2403        $chartPoints['currency'][] = [

2408                + collect($actions)->sum(fn (array $action) => (int) ($action['gold_dust_spent'] ?? 0)),
2409            'gold_dust_gained' => $goldDustGained,
2410            'copper_coins_spent' => collect($actions)->sum(fn (array $action) => (int) ($action['copper_coins_spent'] ?? 0)),
2411            'shards_spent' => $shardsSpent,
2412            'shards_gained' => 0,
2413            'listed_value' => $listedValue,
2414        ];
2415        $chartPoints['outcomes'][] = [
2416            'tick' => $tick,
2417            'successful' => $outcomeCounts['successful'],
2418            'failed' => $outcomeCounts['failed'],
2419            'destroyed' => $outcomeCounts['destroyed'],
2420            'skipped' => $outcomeCounts['skipped'],
2421        ];
2422        $chartPoints['gold_dust'][] = ['tick' => $tick, 'gained' => $goldDustGained];
2423
2424        $progress['chart_points'] = $chartPoints;
2425        $progress['currency_totals'] = $this->accumulatedCurrencyTotals($progress, $currency, $spent, $actions);

2476    private function accumulatedCurrencyTotals(array $progress, string $currency, int $spent, array $actions): array

3298            }

3300            if (! empty($itemApplications)) {

4074    /**

4077     * Amount, Craft and Enchant Set). Backward-compatible: missing/older batches default

4187    private function validateCraftSetPlan(Character $character, array $queue, array $keys, array $plan): void
4188    {

4191        foreach ($keys as $index => $key) {

4193            $target = $queue[$index];

4199            if (! isset($entry['selected_item_id']) || is_null($entry['selected_item_id'])) {

4203                    ]);

4209            $selectedItemId = (int) $entry['selected_item_id'];
4210            $selectedItem = $candidates->first(fn ($candidate) => (int) $candidate->id === $selectedItemId);
4211
4212            if (is_null($selectedItem)) {

4217
4218            if ($isHand) {

4222                    ]);
4223                }
4224
4225                $selectedHands->push($selectedItem);
4226            }
4227        }
4228
4229        if (! $this->setHandsValidation->areHandItemsValid($selectedHands)) {
4230            throw ValidationException::withMessages([

4232            ]);
4233        }

4325    private function mapExistingSetSlotsToPlanKeys(InventorySet $set, array $keys): array

4333            if (! isset($slotsByType[$type]) || $slotsByType[$type]->isEmpty()) {
4334                continue;

4336
4337            $mapped[$key] = $slotsByType[$type]->shift()->id;

4343    private function validateCraftEnchantSetPlan(Character $character, array $queue, array $keys, array $plan): void
4344    {
4345        $missingKeys = array_values(array_diff($keys, array_keys($plan)));
4346
4347        if (! empty($missingKeys)) {
4348            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
4349                'progress.enchant_plan' => 'Every item in the full set must have a prefix or a suffix selected.',
4350            ]);
4351        }
4352
4353        $prefixIds = [];
4354        $suffixIds = [];
4355
4356        foreach ($keys as $index => $key) {
4357            $entry = is_array($plan[$key] ?? null) ? $plan[$key] : [];
4358            $prefixId = isset($entry['prefix_affix_id']) ? (int) $entry['prefix_affix_id'] : null;
4359            $suffixId = isset($entry['suffix_affix_id']) ? (int) $entry['suffix_affix_id'] : null;
4360
4361            if (is_null($prefixId) && is_null($suffixId)) {
4362                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
4363                    'progress.enchant_plan' => 'Every item in the full set must have a prefix or a suffix selected.',
4364                ]);
4365            }
4366
4367            if (! is_null($prefixId)) {
4368                $prefixIds[] = $prefixId;
4369            }
4370
4371            if (! is_null($suffixId)) {
4372                $suffixIds[] = $suffixId;
4373            }
4374
4375            if (isset($entry['selected_item_id']) && ! is_null($entry['selected_item_id'])) {
4376                $target = $queue[$index];
4377                $candidates = $this->processor->craftableItemCandidatesForTarget($character, $target['type'], $target['crafting_type']);
4378                $selectedItemId = (int) $entry['selected_item_id'];
4379
4380                if (! $candidates->contains(fn ($candidate) => (int) $candidate->id === $selectedItemId)) {
4381                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
4382                        'progress.enchant_plan' => 'One or more selected items are not craftable by this character for the matching slot.',
4383                    ]);
4384                }
4385            }
4386        }
4387
4388        $prefixAffixes = ItemAffix::whereIn('id', $prefixIds)->get();
4389        $suffixAffixes = ItemAffix::whereIn('id', $suffixIds)->get();
4390
4391        if ($prefixAffixes->count() !== count(array_unique($prefixIds)) || $prefixAffixes->contains(fn (ItemAffix $affix) => $affix->type !== 'prefix')) {
4392            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
4393                'progress.enchant_plan' => 'One or more selected prefix enchantments are invalid.',
4394            ]);
4395        }
4396
4397        if ($suffixAffixes->count() !== count(array_unique($suffixIds)) || $suffixAffixes->contains(fn (ItemAffix $affix) => $affix->type !== 'suffix')) {
4398            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
4399                'progress.enchant_plan' => 'One or more selected suffix enchantments are invalid.',
4400            ]);
4401        }
4402
4403        $this->validateAffixesAvailableByEnchantingLevel($character, $prefixAffixes->merge($suffixAffixes));
4404    }

4406    private function resolveSetPlanSelectedItemIds(Character $character, array $queue, array $keys, array $plan): array
4407    {

4410        foreach ($keys as $index => $key) {
